why: All four must_catch items are handled. (1) Check 3 runs `a.jsonl missing.jsonl bad.jsonl b.jsonl` in one command. It requires exit 2, a stderr message that names missing.jsonl, and stdout "still holding `/tmp/jl-verify/bad.jsonl:2: ...`". (2) Check 4 runs `git diff --exit-code b74bddb HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` against the base commit and requires no diff output. (3) Builder step 4 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" and lists the multi-file usage, `-` for stdin and the exit codes. (4) Check 6 runs `gh pr view` for the state, body and headRefOid, and `gh pr checks`. It requires the Closes line in the body, headRefOid equal to the commit checked, and the `test` check passing at that head.
